title: Preserve and fix baseline correctness

commands.note: 73 tests, 72 pass, 1 skipped (Node engine range), 0 fail

tests.name: full suite
tests.detail: 73 tests / 0 failures after the fixes below

findings: test/engine.test.js expected meta.status 'empty' from a nonsense query over real backends. That is unreachable: zvec is hybrid and its vector leg always returns nearest neighbours, so the `No matches.` sentinel that src/backends/zvec.js:17 keys on never appears over a non-empty index. Confirmed by running the pinned zg 0.2.1 CLI directly. The product was correct; the test assumption was not. The case now pins the reachable contract instead: status ok, stopReason plan_complete, and every evidence descriptor opaque, which is the real regression guard (CLI prose must never become a typed locator). The reachable `empty` contract stays pinned on the captured fixture in test/backends.test.js.

Second latent bad assertion at the same test: `meta.backends[].backend` is 'serena' while `meta.routes` is 'serena:references', so `routes.includes(backend)` could never hold. Replaced with the real invariant, that each reported backend is the backend part of some planned route.

Third: the cancellation case passed maxChars 100000, above the 4000..80000 bound enforced by src/engine.js:387, so the request failed input validation instead of being cancelled. The bound is correct product behaviour; the test now uses 80000.
`npm test` was `node --test` with no scope, which after vendoring started executing the upstream trees' own test suites. Scoped to test/**/*.test.js.
rollback: Revert test/engine.test.js and the package.json scripts block. No product behaviour changed in this unit.
